backend.stack: NestJS 11 + Fastify + Prisma + PostgreSQL + RabbitMQ + Redis

verdict.justification: P0 blocker: frontend build fails. P1 critical: registration endpoint requires authentication. P1 critical: backend coverage 67.37% below 80% threshold. P2 major: notification polling causes cascading rate limit failures.

phase_summary.name: Pre-flight
phase_summary.notes: All services up, 42 migrations applied, pnpm installed

phase_summary.name: Static Analysis
phase_summary.notes: Frontend build fails (2 TS errors); 261 ESLint errors frontend; 191 as-any backend

phase_summary.name: Service Startup
phase_summary.notes: Backend port 3000 healthy; frontend port 5173 healthy

phase_summary.name: Authentication
phase_summary.notes: Core auth works; access token remains valid 24h after logout

phase_summary.name: RBAC
phase_summary.notes: TL role missing from PM and QA dashboard endpoints

phase_summary.name: UI Functional
phase_summary.notes: All pages load; WebSocket 3-5s connection delay; 3x 429 on executions page

phase_summary.name: API Contracts
phase_summary.notes: PATCH status accepts wrong field; /decisions and /observability 404

phase_summary.name: Data Integrity
phase_summary.notes: CRUD, unicode, 5x concurrent creates all pass; duplicate returns 500 not 409

phase_summary.name: Security
phase_summary.notes: No HTTP security headers; /metrics and /docs open in dev; 27+ dep vulns

phase_summary.name: Performance
phase_summary.notes: 3.24MB JS bundle exceeds 2.5MB threshold; all API responses <10ms

phase_summary.name: Accessibility
phase_summary.notes: 7 WCAG violations on login page (landmark elements)

phase_summary.name: Regression
phase_summary.notes: Bugs #1,#2 resolved; #3,#4,#5,#6 still open; #7 partially resolved

phase_summary.name: Exploratory

phase_summary.name: Production Readiness
phase_summary.notes: REDIS_URL missing; no security headers; /metrics and /docs must be gated for production

defects.title: Frontend production build fails with TypeScript unused import errors
defects.actual: Exit code 2: TS6133 errors for unused imports 'Input' and 'CardHeader'
defects.suggested_fix: Remove unused import 'Input' from EditUserModal.tsx:12 and 'CardHeader' from UsersTable.tsx:32

defects.title: Registration endpoint requires authentication — new user onboarding broken
defects.steps_to_reproduce: POST /api/v1/auth/register with valid inviteToken body (no Authorization header)
defects.actual: 401 Unauthorized — missing @Public() decorator on register endpoint
defects.suggested_fix: Add @Public() decorator to RegistrationController.register() method

defects.title: Backend test coverage 67.37% — below 80% mandatory threshold
defects.suggested_fix: Write tests for uncovered modules; target 80% across all metrics

defects.title: Frontend has 261 ESLint errors (no-explicit-any violations)
defects.suggested_fix: Replace any types with proper TypeScript types

defects.title: TL role denied access to PM Dashboard and QA Dashboard (spec violation)
defects.actual: 403 Forbidden — TL not in @Roles decorator for PM or QA dashboards
defects.suggested_fix: Add 'TL' to @Roles decorator in both dashboard controllers

defects.title: Backend has 1 critical, 26 high dependency vulnerabilities
defects.suggested_fix: Run pnpm audit fix; update vulnerable packages

defects.title: Frontend has 9 high dependency vulnerabilities
defects.suggested_fix: Run pnpm audit fix; update typescript-eslint to fix minimatch ReDoS

defects.title: Notifications polling triggers cascading rate limit (429) causing UI failures
defects.steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to /executions page; observe browser console
defects.expected: Notifications load without rate limit errors
defects.suggested_fix: Add @SkipThrottle() to notification polling endpoint OR add exponential backoff in frontend

defects.title: Access token remains valid 24h after logout (no token blacklist)
defects.steps_to_reproduce: Login → logout → use old access token on /auth/me
defects.suggested_fix: Implement Redis-based access token blacklist or reduce TTL to 15min

defects.title: PATCH /projects/:id/status accepts wrong field {status: inactive} returning 200
defects.suggested_fix: Add forbidNonWhitelisted DTO validation to reject unknown fields

defects.title: Duplicate project creation (same clickup_list_id) returns 500 instead of 409
defects.steps_to_reproduce: Create 2 projects with same clickup_list_id concurrently
defects.suggested_fix: Catch Prisma P2002 unique constraint violation and return 409 Conflict

defects.title: REDIS_URL environment variable missing from .env
defects.actual: Key absent; Redis running natively but not configured via env
defects.suggested_fix: Add REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379 to .env and .env.example

defects.title: Missing HTTP security response headers (X-Frame-Options, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options)
defects.suggested_fix: Register @fastify/helmet in main.ts: app.register(helmet)

defects.title: API responses use snake_case field names instead of camelCase
defects.suggested_fix: Configure NestJS ClassSerializerInterceptor with camelCase transformation

defects.title: Main JS bundle 3.24MB exceeds 2.5MB warning threshold
defects.suggested_fix: Implement route-level code splitting; lazy-load react-pdf

defects.title: 7 WCAG accessibility violations on login page (landmark elements)
defects.suggested_fix: Add <main> landmark; wrap page sections in appropriate semantic HTML

defects.title: 4 Recharts dimension warnings on PM Dashboard (REGRESSION BUG #4)
defects.steps_to_reproduce: Load PM Dashboard; open browser console
defects.actual: 4x 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'
defects.suggested_fix: Wrap charts in ResizeObserver or use conditional rendering until dimensions available

defects.title: Backend code quality: 12 console.log, 3 @ts-ignore, 191 as-any casts
defects.steps_to_reproduce: grep -r console.log src/; grep -r @ts-ignore src/; grep -rn 'as any' src/
defects.suggested_fix: Use Winston Logger; remove @ts-ignore with proper types; reduce as-any casts

defects.title: WebSocket initial 3-5s delay showing 'Connecting...' state
defects.steps_to_reproduce: Load PM Dashboard; observe WebSocket badge on initial render
defects.suggested_fix: Add skeleton loading state; consider eager connection in AuthContext

defects.title: /metrics and /api/v1/docs-json accessible without authentication in dev
defects.expected: Dev: acceptable; Production: must require auth
defects.suggested_fix: Disable docs in production via NODE_ENV check; add IP allowlist for /metrics
